title: Fiber uplink failure on aggregation router caused loss of three downstream sites
alarm_pattern: interface_down on aggregation uplink followed by backhaul_lost and service_unavailable on 3 downstream base stations
root_cause: Fiber cut on uplink span due to civil works
resolution: Field team dispatched, fiber spliced; traffic restored after OTDR test

title: Aggregation router SFP failure isolated two base stations
alarm_pattern: interface_down with rising CRC errors then backhaul_lost on 2 base stations
root_cause: Faulty SFP optic module on access-facing interface
resolution: SFP replaced under approved MOP, interface errors cleared

title: Configuration change on aggregation router dropped downstream connectivity
alarm_pattern: interface_down after config commit; bgp_neighbor_down; backhaul_lost on downstream sites
root_cause: Incorrect VLAN configuration pushed during change window
resolution: Configuration rolled back to last known good after CAB approval

title: Core link congestion during evening peak
alarm_pattern: high_utilization, high_latency and packet_loss on core uplink; no interface down
root_cause: Traffic growth exceeded link capacity during peak hours
resolution: Traffic engineering: load shared onto backup path, capacity upgrade ticket raised

title: Base station power outage
alarm_pattern: power_failure, node_unreachable on one base station; upstream router healthy
root_cause: Commercial power failure at site, battery depleted
resolution: Power restored by utility; generator dispatched for resilience

title: Aggregation router reboot after software crash
alarm_pattern: node_unreachable then device_restart on aggregation router; all downstream backhaul_lost briefly
root_cause: Software process crash (routing daemon) triggered watchdog reboot
resolution: Device recovered automatically; vendor TAC case opened, patch scheduled

title: Microwave backhaul degradation due to rain fade
alarm_pattern: high_packet_loss and high_jitter on microwave link, link flapping
root_cause: Heavy rain attenuation on microwave hop
resolution: Adaptive modulation adjusted, monitored until weather cleared

title: False packet loss alarm from faulty probe
alarm_pattern: packet_loss reported 100% by one probe while interface counters and services normal

title: Core router line card failure
alarm_pattern: linecard_failure, multiple interface_down on core router, traffic rerouted
root_cause: Hardware failure on line card slot 2
resolution: Line card replaced under maintenance window, traffic shifted to CR-02

title: Routing issue after BGP session flap
alarm_pattern: bgp_neighbor_down, route_withdrawn, latency increase on alternate path
resolution: BGP dampening applied, provider ticket raised

title: Access switch failure took down three base stations
alarm_pattern: node_unreachable on access switch then backhaul_lost on 3 base stations

title: Traffic shift caused congestion after link failure
alarm_pattern: interface_down on primary uplink, high_utilization on backup path, latency increase
root_cause: Primary link failure shifted traffic to lower-capacity backup
resolution: Primary link repaired; backup capacity review raised

title: Enterprise link down due to customer premises issue
alarm_pattern: interface_down on enterprise gateway, upstream aggregation router healthy

title: High CPU on aggregation router degraded forwarding
alarm_pattern: high_cpu, increased latency and jitter on all downstream sites, no interface down
root_cause: Control-plane storm from misconfigured protocol timer
resolution: Protocol timers corrected, CoPP policy reviewed
